objective.name: infer
objective.description: Route a canonical LLM inference request to the capacity responsible for its declared provider.

#root.role: Route an inference request to the provider capacity identified by the provider parameter and return its canonical response, without reading the request.

request._comment: Required request conforming to /root/llm/schema/request. Transit parameter: forwarded as is to the provider capacity and never read by the router, so it may arrive as a value or as a transit reference.

provider._comment: Required. Provider that executes the inference (openai, anthropic, mistral, scaleway, fake or recorded). It must be the provider declared in request.provider: the router reads only this parameter, never the request.

transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request addressed to a provider becomes the canonical response returned by that provider capacity.
invariants: The request is forwarded without cognitive modification.
infer performs no provider API adaptation.
The provider capacity is responsible for provider-specific adaptation, execution, and response normalization.
The request and the response are transit values: no Matter is read, written or created, and nothing is persisted.
The provider parameter is mandatory and is the only input of the provider selection.
The request is opaque to infer: its content (model, messages, parameters, requirements) is never read by the router and is validated by the provider capacity.
The provider parameter designates the same provider as request.provider; keeping them consistent is the caller's responsibility.
success: The declared provider corresponds to a supported provider capacity.
The selected provider capacity completes successfully.
The provider capacity returns a canonical response.
failure: The selected provider capacity returns an error.
